d: In India Angle, episode 4 by Sidhant Sibal. It was a packed week, but a week with Diwali celebrations, from Singapore to London. In US, the Blue wave saw Democrats take control of the US Congress as Trump faced mid term shocker. For India, lots at stake with an unfinished trade deal, and more negotiating room. EAM Jaishankar attended the G20 FMs meet, Quad FMs meet and the commonwealth summit even as Foreign secretary Vikram Misri was in Nepal ahead of Nepal PM Balen Shah’s India visit.
